nodes.label: Advisor-Executor Pattern
nodes.summary: A cost-control agent pattern: Opus 4.7 advises (read-only brief) → Sonnet executes → Haiku cleans. Delivers near-Opus quality at ~1.3x pure-Sonnet cost instead of ~5x pure-Opus.

nodes.label: Vertical Knowledge-Base Moat
